    "ad4a2bc2: ;If the value is longer than 19 characters, and the DATA VALIDATION\n ;field does not contain 'I' (INTERNAL), and it contains 'F' (FREE TEXT)\n ;or 'K' (NUMERIC EXPRESSION), go to the RW^DIR2 routine.",
    "cf6a4b77: ;If the DATA VALIDATION field contains 'I' (INTERNAL), and the DE\n ;array contains a value for the current field, display a message\n ;indicating that editing is not allowed.",
    "a7c0343c: ;Read user input into the X variable, with a timeout specified by\n ;DTIME. If the user times out, set DTOUT and X to the up-arrow\n ;character and beep.",

    "78d64664: ;Kill the DQ(DQ) array element and increment DQ.",
    "ac479649: ;Branch to the label specified by DQ.",
    "a5edde5c: ;If the DE array contains a value for the current field, go to the\n ;PR label. Otherwise, write the field label and read user input.",

    "968d7f9f: If no match is found, display the remaining unmatched part of the option line.",
    "667996c0: If the input variable allows pointer selection, initiate the pointer lookup routine.",
    "d5f5a2d3: If the input variable does not allow new values and the user's input exceeds the maximum length, reject the input.",
